watch.text: QB Tait Reynolds is out for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back'; third-stringer Trent Pearman starts vs South Carolina.
Swinney expects LB Jeremiah Alexander back after missing Duke and hopes WR Tyler Brown and CB Elliot Washington II return for South Carolina.
QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) missed the Arkansas loss and returned vs Georgia on Nov. 21 (87 passing yards, 1 INT in a 34-6 loss); our ratings carry the game without him.
WR Mazeo Bennett Jr., DB Judge Collier and edge Anthony Addison were downgraded to out for Georgia on Friday; WR Nyck Harbor is available.
QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body, hurt Nov. 14 vs Louisville) did not start at Virginia; freshman Travis Burgess made his first start in a 41-24 loss on Nov. 21.
QB Julian Sayin has missed every game since Oct. 17 with Luke Fahey starting; Rotowire estimates a Nov. 28 return (Michigan). Not confirmed by Ohio State.
QB Katin Houser is not likely to play vs Iowa after broken-nose surgery; Michael Clayton II starts. The line moved from Iowa -6.5 to -9.5.
Starter Kamario Taylor is out for the season (foot) and fill-in AJ Swann is hurt; Lebby says the Egg Bowl QB depends on Swann's practice, with Billy Puckett the alternative.
FSU had its top four RBs out (No. 5 Zay Parks started) in the 28-10 home loss to NC State on Nov. 21; edge Rylan Kennedy and RB Amari Thomas are out for the season.
QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Nov. 21 Chattanooga win; DeBoer expects him 'full speed, full go' this week for Auburn.
QB Jared Curtis aggravated a lingering left wrist injury vs Florida on Nov. 21 but returned; Clark Lea expects him to practice and start vs Tennessee.
QB Steve Angeli (AC joint, right shoulder, hurt Nov. 21 at BC) ruled out vs Notre Dame by Fran Brown on Monday; Malachi Nelson starts. Our ratings were built with Angeli.
QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT vs Michigan on Nov. 21 (left leg); X-rays reportedly negative, USC status uncertain. Nico Iamaleava is out for the year.
RB Kewan Lacy is out for the season and RB Shekai Mills-Knight has a high ankle sprain (Pete Golding, Nov. 17); our ratings were built mostly with Lacy.
QB Mason Heintschel tore his ACL in early October; Pitt is 1-5 since and Narduzzi has not named a starter (Holden Geriner or Corey Dailey) for Cal.
Starting QB Tayven Jackson (upper body) misses the UAB game; Chris Jimerson Jr. starts and backup Chaston Ditta is also hurt.
QB Alonza Barnett III missed five games with a hamstring injury and has started the last three since returning; ratings still carry the games without him.
C Bray Lynch (lower leg) and WR Nick Marsh were hurt in the Nov. 21 OT loss at Washington, G Joe Brunner is out for the year, and Cignetti hasn't named a QB for Purdue.
QB Conner Weigman (shoulder) missed the Nov. 21 West Virginia win and is working to return for Baylor; freshman Keisean Henderson started.
QB Kevin Jennings hurt his ankle in the 2nd quarter of the Nov. 21 loss at Notre Dame and was limited, per Rhett Lashlee; no status yet for Stanford.
Colton Joseph returned as Wisconsin's starting QB in the Nov. 21 win at Purdue after freshman Ryan Hopkins was hurt; the Badgers started Hopkins in earlier games.
Starting QB Micah Alejado was carted off with a lower-leg injury on Nov. 21 at Nevada; no diagnosis yet, so he may miss the Sacramento State finale.
QB Michael Van Buren (8 starts) has been out since Oct. 31; Luke Kromenhoek has started since and USF has lost three straight.
USF parted ways with offensive coordinator Tim Beck after the Nov. 21 loss at FAU, one game before the finale.
QB Bishop Davenport returned as the starter on Nov. 7 after missing games with an injury; earlier games without him still weigh on our rating.
Coach Scotty Walden fired mid-November (interim Kyle Beyer), and starting QB EJ Colson is out with Raymond Moore III starting.
Washington State has slumped badly, capped by a 42-14 loss at Texas State on Nov. 21; QB Owen Eshelman played the whole game, no injury reported.
QB Pop Watson re-injured his ankle early vs Toledo after missing two October games; he was on the injury report before Akron and his status for Bowling Green is unknown.
Starting QB Angel Flores is out for the season after ankle surgery; Jadyn Glasser starts.
Starting QB Cameran Brown has missed several games (Ayden Pereira starting) and may return for the Nov. 28 finale.

401856765.summary: Tennessee has lost several starters for the season (WR Mike Matthews among them), which covers some of the gap; Vanderbilt QB Jared Curtis is expected to start.

reasons.text: WR Mike Matthews (knee) is out for the season; George MacIntyre's knee was not expected to cost him time.
Clark Lea expects QB Jared Curtis (wrist) to practice and start vs Tennessee.

401858540.summary: Ohio State is still without QB Julian Sayin (Luke Fahey has started since Oct. 17) and no return is confirmed; that covers part of a 7-point gap, not all of it.

reasons.text: Rotowire lists Sayin (throwing arm) out with an estimated return of Nov. 28; Ohio State has not confirmed he will play Michigan.
Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with Fahey at QB, its 4th loss.

swings.Ohio State: Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska on Nov. 21 with QB Julian Sayin still out (Eleven Warriors); the market marked the Buckeyes down more than our ratings did.

401856873.summary: Nothing found explains it: no Arizona or Arizona State injury news turned up, and Arizona's OT win at Kansas State points toward our side.

reasons.text: Arizona beat Kansas State 35-28 in OT on Nov. 21; Noah Fifita threw for 323 yards and 2 TDs.
Arizona State lost 30-27 in OT to Oklahoma State on Nov. 21 after leading by 17 at halftime; QB Jake Fette threw the OT interception.

401856759.summary: FSU is badly depleted (top four RBs out in the 28-10 home loss to NC State, edge Rylan Kennedy lost for the year), which explains part of the market's lean to Florida.

reasons.text: FSU lost 28-10 at home to NC State on Nov. 21 with its top four RBs out; Ashton Daniels threw 2 INTs.

401858543.summary: UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach's status for USC is uncertain after being carted off vs Michigan (X-rays reportedly negative); the market had USC -10.5 before that injury.

reasons.text: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT of the Nov. 21 loss to Michigan; X-rays were reportedly negative and further tests are needed.
Nico Iamaleava is already out for the season (torn ACL), so Madden Iamaleava would likely start for UCLA.
DraftKings listed USC -10.5 on Nov. 16; the SP+ projection is UCLA by 6.8, close to our line.

swings.UCLA: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT vs Michigan on Nov. 21 and his USC status is uncertain (ESPN); our ratings don't see it, the market does.
swings.USC: Mostly the other side of UCLA's QB injury: Ty Dieffenbach was carted off Nov. 21 vs Michigan, so the market moved toward USC (ESPN).

reasons.text: Kalen DeBoer expects QB Keelon Russell (ankle) to be 'full speed, full go' in practice this week after sitting out the Chattanooga game.
Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-10 on Nov. 21; Tristan Ti'a threw for 341 yards and four first-half TDs.

swings.Auburn: No Auburn injury news found; Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-10 on Nov. 21 (Tristan Ti'a 341 yds), and Alabama QB Keelon Russell sat out Chattanooga before being expected back.

401856762.summary: Mississippi State's QB for the Egg Bowl is undecided (injured AJ Swann or Billy Puckett) with starter Kamario Taylor out for the year; the line has moved toward Ole Miss.

reasons.text: QB Kamario Taylor is out for the season (foot surgery, announced Oct. 27); fill-in AJ Swann was hurt again at Auburn.
Jeff Lebby on Nov. 22: the starter 'will really depend on how AJ is able to practice this week'; Billy Puckett started the Tennessee Tech win.

swings.Mississippi State: QB AJ Swann is hurt and the Egg Bowl starter is undecided (Lebby, Nov. 22, Clarion-Ledger); backup Billy Puckett started the Nov. 21 win.
swings.Ole Miss: Nothing found: the market moved on Ole Miss without a clear reason (it lost RB Kewan Lacy for the season, which points the other way); its last game was vs FCS Wofford.

401866472.summary: Forecast wind of about 16 mph (gusts 30+) at Akron and our SP+ input running far above Sagarin explain part of the gap; no new Buffalo or Akron injury news found.

reasons.text: Forecast for Nov. 27 at Akron: wind about 16 mph with gusts over 30, which tends to compress margins toward the underdog.
Buffalo QB E. Holmes (knee) was shut down for the season about three weeks ago; the market has had time to price it.

swings.Buffalo: Buffalo has won six straight (40-21 over Central Michigan on 11/18, Messiah Burch 200 rush yds); our ratings rose with the streak more than the market, which still prices QB E. Holmes's season-ending knee injury (UB Athletics).

401871062.summary: Jacksonville State has already clinched its CUSA title-game spot (vs Liberty), so this game means less to it; Delaware just won 42-30 behind 5 TD passes. SP+ (-9.4) is far from Sagarin (-0.3).

reasons.text: Jax State clinched a third straight CUSA title-game berth with a 25-20 comeback win over Missouri State on Nov. 21; Liberty is the opponent.
Delaware QB Nick Minicucci threw 5 TDs (31-of-41, 398 yds) in a 42-30 win at New Mexico State; the Blue Hens are 6-5 and bowl-eligible.

swings.Delaware: Delaware won 42-30 at New Mexico State on Nov. 21 with Nick Minicucci throwing 5 TDs; the market moved up on the Blue Hens, while Jax State has a title game next (ESPN, 11/21).

401864549.summary: No injury or QB news found for either team; Nathan Hayes is NDSU's starter and Luke Weaver started SJSU's last game. Our line leans on SP+ far more than Sagarin.

reasons.text: San José State fell 24-22 to UNLV on Nov. 21 when Luke Weaver's tying 2-point pass fell incomplete; Weaver played the whole game.

401871063.summary: Liberty (10-1, 7-0 CUSA) has clinched the CUSA title game, so this regular-season finale is low-stakes for it; no injury news found. SP+ and our model run far above Sagarin.

reasons.text: Liberty had already clinched a CUSA title-game spot before Week 12 and will face Jacksonville State.
Liberty beat Western Kentucky 45-14 on Nov. 21 for its 10th straight win; QB Deshawn Purdie threw for 344 yds, no injuries reported.
Missouri State QB Henry Belin played the whole 25-20 loss at Jacksonville State on Nov. 21 (20-of-29, 161 yds); no injury reported.

401862843.summary: North Texas starting QB Tayven Jackson will miss the UAB game (upper body), with sophomore Chris Jimerson Jr. starting and backup Chaston Ditta also hurt; our ratings were built with Jackson.

reasons.text: Neal Brown: Jackson 'will definitely miss Saturday and then the UAB game as well'; he hopes Jackson is back for a title or bowl game.
Chris Jimerson Jr. starts until Jackson returns; backup Chaston Ditta has been out since an October injury.

401858315.summary: Pitt is 1-5 since QB Mason Heintschel's ACL tear and has no named starter for Cal after a 42-10 loss at Louisville; our ratings still carry his early games.

reasons.text: Narduzzi has called Holden Geriner the starter when healthy; Geriner went 12-of-20 for 80 yards with 2 INTs in the 42-10 loss at Louisville.
Heintschel's season ended with a torn ACL.

401858316.summary: SMU QB Kevin Jennings hurt his ankle in the loss at Notre Dame and was limited, which covers part of the gap; Stanford just reached bowl eligibility.

reasons.text: Rhett Lashlee said QB Kevin Jennings hurt his ankle in the 2nd quarter at Notre Dame on Nov. 21, limiting his mobility.
Stanford won the Big Game 44-28 at Cal on Nov. 21 (Davis Warren 2 TD, Micah Ford 151 rush yds) and is 6-5, bowl-eligible for the first time since 2018.

401866475.summary: UMass QB Pop Watson's ankle is a question mark after the 34-33 loss to Akron, which could explain part of the market's lean to Bowling Green; SP+ (-6.4) and Sagarin (+2.8) disagree.

reasons.text: UMass QB Pop Watson's availability after an ankle injury was flagged before the Akron game; no update found for the Bowling Green trip.
Bowling Green's offense has been opened up for QB Jay Kastanin, per a Nov. 20 Toledo preview.
UMass QB Pop Watson left the Toledo game limping and was back on the injury report before Akron; no update for Bowling Green found.

401866474.summary: Central Michigan's starting QB Angel Flores is out for the season after ankle surgery (Jadyn Glasser starts), and CMU just lost 40-21 at Buffalo; our ratings still carry some Flores games.

reasons.text: Angel Flores will miss the rest of 2026 after ankle surgery, per Mitten Football; Jadyn Glasser starts in his place.
Buffalo beat Central Michigan 40-21 on Nov. 18 behind Messiah Burch's 200 rushing yards.

401864550.summary: UTEP fired coach Scotty Walden (interim Kyle Beyer) and is still without QB EJ Colson, with Raymond Moore III starting; that covers part of the market's lean to Northern Illinois.

reasons.text: UTEP (1-9) fired Scotty Walden after an 8th straight loss; DC Kyle Beyer is interim coach for the Air Force and Northern Illinois games.
QB EJ Colson remained out for the Nov. 20 Air Force game; Raymond Moore III started, and Week 13 is Colson's last chance to play.
Northern Illinois QB Taron Dickens threw 3 TDs in the 31-25 loss at North Dakota State on Nov. 21; NIU is 0-11.

401862841.summary: No Army or Rice injury news found; Army has lost two straight (10-6 to East Carolina on Nov. 21) and Rice just got its first FBS win, but our ratings already count those games.

reasons.text: East Carolina beat Army 10-6 at Michie Stadium on Nov. 21; Army ran for 180 yards vs a 324.7 average and fell to 5-5.
Rice beat Temple 31-27 on Nov. 19 with three QBs (Crayton Jr., Brown, Ochoa) involved in the late comeback.

401858311.summary: Miami is still without WR Malachi Toney (ankle) and TE Elija Lofton left the Virginia Tech game hurt; real but small next to a 3.7-point gap.

reasons.text: Toney had surgery on a high ankle sprain from a Nov. 4 practice; Cristobal says he is about 1.5 weeks out, so the BC game looks unlikely.

401860928.summary: Nothing found justifies the shorter number: Texas State just beat Washington State 42-14 and Utah State (4-7, out of bowl range) lost 31-24 at Oregon State; no QB news for either.

reasons.text: Utah State lost 31-24 at Oregon State on Nov. 21, falling to 4-7.
Texas State beat Washington State 42-14 in San Marcos on Nov. 21.

401869930.summary: South Alabama QB Bishop Davenport returned from injury on Nov. 7, so part of our rating comes from games without him; App State's Malachi Singleton is healthy after a 17-16 OT win over ULM.

reasons.text: Bishop Davenport accounted for two TDs in his first start since an injury in the 28-26 loss at Louisiana on Nov. 7.
App State QB Malachi Singleton threw for 188 yards and 2 TDs in the 17-16 OT win over ULM; no injury news.

returning.text: Back as starting QB since Nov. 7 after missing games with an injury.

401862839.summary: USF has lost three straight, parted ways with OC Tim Beck after the 35-14 loss at FAU, and has started backup Luke Kromenhoek since Van Buren's Oct. 31 injury; that covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: USF lost 35-14 at Florida Atlantic on Nov. 21 (two first-half turnovers by QB Luke Kromenhoek), its third straight loss.
USF and offensive coordinator Tim Beck parted ways after 11 games.
Starter Michael Van Buren was hurt vs UAB on Oct. 31 and ruled out on the availability report for ECU; Kromenhoek has started since.

401864547.summary: Hawai'i starting QB Micah Alejado was carted off with a lower-leg injury in the Nov. 21 loss at Nevada and no diagnosis is out yet; our ratings were built with him.

reasons.text: QB Micah Alejado was carted off after a defender was blocked into his knee in the 16-8 loss at Nevada; Timmy Chang expected a diagnosis later.
Hawai'i managed 182 total yards at Nevada, its lowest total in 11 years.

swings.Georgia State: Starting QB Cameran Brown may return Nov 28 after missing several games (Rotowire, 11/21); the market is pricing a better Georgia State than our ratings, built on his absence.

401869959.summary: Georgia State may get starting QB Cameran Brown back for the finale, which explains some of the market being 3 points closer than us.

reasons.text: Georgia State QB Cameran Brown (undisclosed) has missed several games with Ayden Pereira starting; Nov 21 report says the Louisiana game is his last chance to return.
Louisiana is already bowl eligible (8-3) after beating South Alabama 28-26.

returning.text: Starting QB, out since late October; possible return Nov 28.

swings.Marshall: Carlos Del Rio-Wilson made his first start since Oct. 10 in the 28-27 win over Georgia State (11/21) after Zion Turner and Khalil Wilkins were hurt; our ratings rose, the market less so (WCHS).

401858544.summary: Nothing found justifies the market's shorter number: Colton Joseph returned at QB and Wisconsin beat Purdue, which favors our side. It is a rivalry game with Fickell's job in question.

reasons.text: Colton Joseph returned to the starting lineup in the Nov. 21 win at Purdue after Ryan Hopkins was hurt.

401856875.summary: Nothing found that justifies Colorado (4-7) as a 2-point favorite: UCF's QB Alonza Barnett is back starting after a five-game hamstring absence, which if anything favors our UCF side.

reasons.text: UCF QB Alonza Barnett III missed five games (hamstring) and has started the last three since returning, including a 48-17 win over Iowa State.
Colorado (4-7) lost 35-28 at Cincinnati with QB Isaac Wilson throwing three interceptions; no new Colorado injury news found.

returning.text: Back from a five-game hamstring absence; three starts since.

401858538.summary: Indiana came out of the OT loss at Washington banged up (C Bray Lynch, WR Nick Marsh; G Joe Brunner out) and Cignetti hasn't named a QB, which covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: C Bray Lynch (lower leg) and WR Nick Marsh were hurt at Washington; Cignetti gave no update and hasn't named a QB for Purdue.
Indiana lost 27-24 in OT at Washington; the line opened Indiana -22.5 and has drifted to -21.5.

401860929.summary: San Diego State is already set for the Dec. 4 Pac-12 title game at Boise State, so this is a tune-up for it; that may explain some of the move to Washington State (opened 1, now 2.5).

reasons.text: San Diego State's next game after this one is the Pac-12 title game at Boise State on Dec. 4, so its title-game spot is settled.
Washington State lost 42-14 at Texas State on Nov 21, its worst loss of the season, extending a long losing run.
San Diego State beat Washington State 26-20 on Oct 31 even without QB Jayden Denegal (ankle); no current SDSU QB news found.

swings.Ohio: Nothing found: the market moved on Ohio without a clear reason; no current Ohio or Toledo QB news turned up.

401858314.summary: Syracuse loses starting QB Steve Angeli (shoulder) for the finale and starts Malachi Nelson, which our ratings don't see; that covers most of our 3.8-pt gap.

reasons.text: Fran Brown ruled QB Steve Angeli out Monday with an AC joint injury in his right shoulder from the Nov. 21 BC loss; Malachi Nelson starts.
Nelson re-aggravated his ankle late in the BC game, so the backup is not fully healthy either.
